port_scope: Five exact terminal status categories and count/pass semantics, split into generic checked-int64 Step and public-nonempty Finish. Does not implement canonical ledger creation/parsing or the full upstream schema.
original_composition: CompletionReady applies operator-required claim coverage and summary consistency; it is not an upstream REA function.

deliberate_boundaries.private_summarize_empty: The private upstream summarize([]) returns total0 and complete=true.
deliberate_boundaries.public_ledger_nonempty: The upstream public records and summary schema require at least one record; CompletionFinish rejects zero with NO_RECORDS.
deliberate_boundaries.counter_domain: Checked nonnegative int64 Gooo counters. This is a deliberate numeric-domain extension, not a claim of all JavaScript Number or RFC8785 compatibility.
